description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseClock' for clock implementations within the Pipecat project. It specifies a common interface for timing operations such as getting the current time and starting the clock, which are meant to be implemented by concrete subclasses.

classes.name: BaseClock
classes.description: An abstract base class providing a common interface for clock implementations in Pipecat, including methods for retrieving the current time and starting the clock.

methods.name: int get_time(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the current time value. Implementation should return the current time as an integer, with unit and reference point defined by subclasses.

methods.name: start(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to start or initialize the clock. Subclasses should implement any necessary setup routines here.
